notes.title: Updated our previous game, the hiphop western Luckslinger!
notes.content:
In Luckslinger, luck is measurable, collectable and usable whenever you please. Contains: gunslingers, dark humor, spaghetti western, vinyl digging, graffiti spraying and jazzy hip hop beats.

Game page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/358810/Luckslinger/

The main changes for the game are:

 More checkpoints in each level! Keeping the clutch gameplay intact but a bit more forgiving overall
 Luckslinger now has stronger leg muscles and can jump higher
 Playstation controller support!
 In the saloon you can acquire another extra HP, allowing the opportunity for 5 HP max
 More health, luck and money drops
 Other small fixes
